safe.question: Are the productivity tools safe to use?
safe.answer: Yes! All calculation, formatting, QR encoding, and color picking processes run fully in your own web browser. Your confidential information never leaves your device or gets saved on external servers.

offline.question: Can I use TechTools without an internet connection?
offline.answer: Yes! Because the utilities process client-side, the page can be fully loaded once, and core features like the Color Picker, Typing Test, and QR Generator will stay operational offline.

accuracy.question: How accurate is the Internet Speed Test?
accuracy.answer: It connects to edge locations to calculate latency, download metrics, and upload bandwidth. Results are highly precise but can vary slightly depending on network traffic or other apps running.

contact.question: How can I contact technical support?
contact.answer: Simply use our Contact Us form page or reach out directly via support@techtools.dev for assistance with bulk operations, API licenses, or reporting bugs.

meta.title: Privacy Policy
meta.description: Learn how TechTools collects, uses, and protects your local browser details.
meta.keywords: privacy, terms, cookies, safety, browser storage

scope.title: 1. Scope & Core Integrity
paragraphs: At TechTools, user privacy is our topmost priority. This policy covers how our web interface handles parameters, payloads, or values processed through our Typing Speed Test, Color Selector, and QR Code Generator.
Because our platform works natively inside your client-side browser, we do not transmit, analyze, sync, or sell any textual content, URLs, uploaded images, or test samples to our servers.

cookies.title: 2. Cookies & Local Storage
paragraphs: We may use standard HTML5 local storage space or secure keys on your immediate device to temporarily store preferences such as chosen display speeds, color extraction history, or customized themes.
These values are stored entirely locally on your machine and can be deleted entirely at any time by clearing your browser cache. We utilize no persistent tracking metrics.

thirdParty.title: 3. Third-Party Integrations & Sizing
paragraphs: Our contact details use EmailJS. By submitting emails or queries through our forms, only specified name, body text, and sender values are delivered to support agents. None of this data is cached on our structural server blocks.

children.title: 4. Children's Privacy Guidelines
paragraphs: Since our educational utilities and diagnostic tests transmit no personal identifiable data, they are fully safe and appropriate for users of all age levels, including children under 13.

mergePdf.name: Merge PDF
mergePdf.short: Combine multiple PDF files into one.
mergePdf.long: Select multiple PDF files, arrange their order with drag-and-drop, and merge them into a single high-quality document.

splitPdf.name: Split PDF
splitPdf.short: Extract specific page ranges from a PDF.
splitPdf.long: Divide a PDF into single pages, or extract specific page ranges (e.g., pages 1-5, 10) into a brand new PDF document.

compressPdf.name: Compress PDF
compressPdf.short: Reduce PDF file size while keeping quality.
compressPdf.long: Optimize files and images inside your PDF to shrink size while maintaining crisp typography and layout resolution.

pdfToWord.name: PDF to Word
pdfToWord.short: Convert PDF to editable DOCX document.
pdfToWord.long: Extract paragraphs, format grids, and transfer tables directly from your PDF into a fully editable Microsoft Word .docx file.

wordToPdf.name: Word to PDF
wordToPdf.short: Convert Word DOCX files to secure PDF.
wordToPdf.long: Process files from DOCX formats into high-fidelity PDF documents with fully preserved alignments, fonts, and elements.

pdfToPowerpoint.name: PDF to PowerPoint
pdfToPowerpoint.long: Structure text layouts and headings from your PDF pages into fully editable, presentation-ready Microsoft PowerPoint slide decks.

powerpointToPdf.name: PowerPoint to PDF
powerpointToPdf.long: Transform presentation visual slides (PPT/PPTX) into high-resolution, easy-to-read PDF pages for seamless sharing.

pdfToExcel.name: PDF to Excel
pdfToExcel.short: Pull tables and data into Excel spreadsheets.
pdfToExcel.long: Extract multi-column grid arrays and formatted table lists from your PDF and populate them into Microsoft Excel.xlsx formats.

excelToPdf.name: Excel to PDF
excelToPdf.short: Print dynamic Excel worksheets to clean PDF.
excelToPdf.long: Format spreadsheet rows and layout grids neatly, setting custom width scaling, and render workbook lines to a ledger PDF.

pdfToJpg.name: PDF to JPG
pdfToJpg.short: Extract all PDF pages into separate images.
pdfToJpg.long: Render each individual page of a PDF document into a sharp, downloadable high-resolution JPEG (.jpg) format.

jpgToPdf.name: JPG to PDF
jpgToPdf.short: Stitch multiple images into a solid PDF.
jpgToPdf.long: Upload custom JPG, PNG, and WebP images, reorder them as desired, combine sizes, and generate a multi-page PDF workbook.

rotatePdf.name: Rotate PDF
rotatePdf.short: Rotate pages of a PDF visually.
rotatePdf.long: Read PDF files page-by-page, visualize them, and rotate them in specific directions (90, 180, 270 degrees) dynamically.

unlockPdf.name: Unlock PDF
unlockPdf.short: Remove security passwords from custom PDFs.
unlockPdf.long: Decrypt protected files, lift general user editing credentials, and download cracked documents without standard security warnings.

protectPdf.name: Protect PDF
protectPdf.short: Encrypt PDF with secure password protection.
protectPdf.long: Lock down your sensitive PDFs by securing files with password parameters that prompt for entry upon opening anywhere.

repairPdf.name: Repair PDF
repairPdf.short: Reconstruct damaged structures or faulty offsets.
repairPdf.long: Standardize formatting streams and rebuild faulty cross-reference tables (XREF) to bypass loading warnings.

editPdf.name: Edit PDF
editPdf.short: Add text labels, shapes, and doodles onto pages.
editPdf.long: Visually superimpose responsive text blocks, shapes, highlight labels, or signature drawings directly onto specified PDF canvas layers.

compressImage.name: Compress Image
compressImage.short: Compress JPG, PNG, SVG, GIF, WEBP, and AVIF.
compressImage.long: Optimize file size while keeping visual quality as high as possible. Compresses JPEG, PNG, WEBP, GIF, and SVG formats in real-time.

resizeImage.name: Resize Image
resizeImage.short: Set width and height dimensions in pixels.
resizeImage.long: Resize image dimensions by percentage or target width/height pixels. Option to lock ratio or select popular social media canvas presets.

cropImage.name: Crop Image
cropImage.short: Crop images with an interactive selection bounding box.
cropImage.long: Remove borders or isolate desired focus bounds using visual anchors. Offers popular custom aspect ratios and cropping templates.

rotateImage.name: Rotate Image
rotateImage.short: Rotate images and flip them on any axis.
rotateImage.long: Flip images horizontally, vertically, or rotate clockwise/counterclockwise by 90-degree steps for perfect alignments.

watermarkImage.name: Watermark Image
watermarkImage.short: Stamp custom text overlays or branding logos.
watermarkImage.long: Secure your creations by superimposing texts or small transparent overlay logos. Adjust position, size, and branding opacity.

removeBackground.name: AI Remove Background
removeBackground.long: Erase solid or complex backgrounds to create clean transparent png files. Leverages client-side edge contrast detection and smart keys filters.

upscaleImage.name: AI Image Upscaler
upscaleImage.short: Upscale resolution using bicubic edge sharpening.
upscaleImage.long: Interpolate pixels up to 4x while applying intelligent unsharp filters to restore detail, sharpen contours, and reduce visual fuzziness.

imageToJpg.name: Convert to JPG
imageToJpg.short: Re-render PNG, WEBP, AVIF, HEIC, TIFF to JPG.
imageToJpg.long: Transconvert multiple layered image formats into standardized, highly compatible JPEG formats in batches.

imageToPng.name: Convert to PNG
imageToPng.short: Transconvert WebP, JPEG, AVIF to PNG formats.
imageToPng.long: Ensure transparency vectors and crisp grids by compiling incoming files into high-fidelity web PNG standard formats.

imageToWebp.name: Convert to WebP
imageToWebp.short: Transform heavy images into optimized WebP.
imageToWebp.long: Convert folders of PNG or JPG files to ultra-lightweight WebP formats to maximize website and application speeds.

imageToAvif.name: Convert to AVIF
imageToAvif.short: Convert images to next-gen AVIF standards.
imageToAvif.long: Export high-fidelity images to AVIF format, combining high quality with smaller files than WebP.

jpgToPng.name: JPG to PNG
jpgToPng.short: Convert JPG files to transparent PNG.
jpgToPng.long: Transform basic flat JPG/JPEG documents into high-color lossless PNG files and preserve original gradients without artifacts.

pngToJpg.name: PNG to JPG
pngToJpg.short: Convert PNG images into highly compatible JPGs.
pngToJpg.long: Flatten alpha transparent PNG vectors into standard rasterized JPEG grids with solid solid backing variables.

webpToJpg.name: WebP to JPG
webpToJpg.short: Decode WebP pages into standard JPG images.
webpToJpg.long: Safely process space-efficient WebP images into static JPEG formats to maintain universal compatibility in local utilities.

webpToPng.name: WebP to PNG
webpToPng.long: Decompress lightweight, web-optimized WebP files back into fully editable, lossless PNG files with layers intact.

gifToJpg.name: GIF to JPG
gifToJpg.short: Convert animated GIF frames into static JPGs.
gifToJpg.long: Isolate individual animation stages from loaded GIFs or output the first frame as a highly lightweight, static JPG snapshot.

svgToPng.name: SVG to PNG
svgToPng.short: Rasterize vector SVGs into rich PNG layouts.
svgToPng.long: Load vector definitions, scale them to crisp dimensions, and compile them into fully compatible, rich rasterized PNG files.

batchConvert.name: Batch Format Converter
batchConvert.short: Cross-convert dozens of image formats at once.
batchConvert.long: Import any mixture of JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF, SVG, BMP, TIFF, ICO images, choose an export format target, and compile them in seconds.

imageEditor.name: Creative Image Editor
imageEditor.long: Draw, doodle, add text boxes, filters (sepia, monochrome, invert), adjust color sliders, scale, crop, and watermarks in a unified workspace.
